title: Effect-scope containment
status: development; accepted under R26 (accepted in part 2026-10-07); non-qualifying

effect_class included by a declared policy inclusion

resources: each member of R equals a member of A
resources: member matched by a digest-bound policy predicate
resources: R names a resource outside A
environment equal
environment different
audience: R is a subset of A
audience: R names a recipient outside A

sensitivity_ceiling: equal labels, no declared order

Presence: policy requires audience; A states it; R omits it
cases.reason: audience is applicable because the policy requires it; it is absent from R, so it is unknown.

cases.title: Presence: policy requires audience; R states it; A omits it
cases.reason: audience is applicable because the policy requires it; it is absent from A, so it is unknown. An absent dimension is never read as unlimited in A.

cases.title: Presence: policy requires audience; neither scope states it
cases.reason: audience is applicable because the policy requires it; absent from both scopes, so it is unknown.

cases.title: Presence: no policy requirement; A states maximum_affected_count; R omits it
cases.reason: maximum_affected_count is applicable because A states it; it is absent from R, so it is unknown, never read as not requested.

cases.title: Presence: no policy requirement; neither scope states audience; every other dimension contained
cases.reason: audience is neither stated nor required, so it is not applicable and not evaluated.

cases.title: Delegation chain: derived grant widens its predecessor
cases.reason: R is contained in every scope, but the leaf grant names res:c, which its predecessor does not grant. Each derived grant's scope MUST be contained in its predecessor's scope.

cases.title: Authorized Use Record action_class outside the grant
cases.reason: record-delete is not a member of the leaf receipt's permitted_action_classes.

cases.title: Policy requires a dimension GKOS does not define (custom-required)
cases.reason: custom-required is required by the policy, so it is applicable, but it is not a GKOS effect-scope dimension and the evaluator cannot compare it. It is unknown and fails closed; it is never dropped. Reviewer mutation r26-REV-011.

cases.title: Policy required_dimensions is null
cases.reason: A required_dimensions declaration that is not a list of dimension names cannot be evaluated; it fails closed.

cases.title: Policy required_dimensions is a single string, not a list
cases.reason: A required_dimensions declaration that is not a list fails closed; it is not read as one dimension or as none.

cases.title: Policy required_dimensions holds a non-text entry
cases.reason: A required_dimensions entry that is not a dimension name fails closed.

cases.title: Policy requires a supported dimension and an unknown one
cases.reason: environment is contained, but colour is a policy-required dimension the evaluator does not support. The unknown required dimension fails closed even when every supported dimension is contained.

notes: Each case gives the requested scope R, the authorizing scopes in chain order (actor standing first), and the policy inputs the evaluation may use. Policy inputs are fixture stand-ins for a digest-bound policy.
Rows R26-A02-01..22 hold every non-tested dimension contained, so each case isolates one table row.

Evaluated by conformance/runner/effect-containment.mjs (evaluateEffectContainment), which takes the requested scope, the authorizing scopes in chain order and the digest-bound policy inputs. The boolean gate-evaluator kind effect-containment is unchanged.
